group_assessment.weighting: A 27-centre real-world collaboration (mostly ERN EpiCARE centres) on highly purified cannabidiol in 266 monogenic epilepsies; WWOX is one Table 2 row of three patients. Credible as a pooled retrospective effectiveness record; per-gene rows of n = 2-3 are flagged by the authors themselves as chance-prone. Not a per-author sweep.
